// Optional companion for the private P04 directory. Include its scoped CSS
// after source CSS. The source-styled constructor remains independent.
package converted

import "github.com/a-h/templ"

// NewDirectoryEnhanced opts into 44px actions, visible Edit focus and wrapping
// of long values. It neither changes Directory nor supplies a backend/state model.
// For empty/partial results the app supplies an honest Introduction and row set.
func NewDirectoryEnhanced(data Directory) (templ.Component, error) {
	content, err := NewDirectoryNavigation(data)
	if err != nil { return nil, err }
	return directoryEnhanced(content), nil
}
